_doc: Recorded sound effects for Wobblers, made with the ElevenLabs sound-generation API (generate.py). name: the sound id src/audio.js plays (one-shots replace the synthesised sound of the same name; loops are ambient beds placed with audio.ambientSpot). n: variants; dur: requested seconds; loop: a seamless ambient loop; level: playback gain.
style: Cheerful, cartoony video game sound effect for a silly physics sandbox with wobbly bean people, clean, no music unless asked.
